rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 31 July 1991, in the Secretariat's English translation of a speech delivered in Bengali, Prof. Sourendra Bhattacharjee (West Bengal) says that 'When Shri P. V. Narasimha Rao became the President of the Congress Party after tha[t] tragic death of Shri Rajiv Gandhi', he said in his first press interview that the Congress stood on the principles laid down by Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru.
